command -v /usr/bin/time || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
MAX=4611686018427387903
streams=32
chunk=bytes(range(256))*8 # 2048 bytes
frames_per_stream=32
config={'early':False,'overlap':'reject','buffer_packets':0,'idle_ms':0,
'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,
'max_data':MAX,'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':{'I':[],'H':[],'A':[]}}
events=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'}]
for s in range(streams):
 frames=[]
 for j in range(frames_per_stream):
  frames.append({'type':'STREAM','id':4*s,'offset':j*2048,'data_hex':chunk.hex(),'fin':j==31})
 events.append({'t':s+1,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':[{'level':'A','pn':s,'auth':True,'frames':frames}]})
req={'version':1,'traces':[{'id':'stress','config':config,'events':events}]}
with open('/app/tmp/stress.json','w') as f: json.dump(req,f,separators=(',',':'))
print('input bytes',__import__('os').path.getsize('/app/tmp/stress.json'))
PY
/usr/bin/time -v python3 -I /app/submission/entry.py < /app/tmp/stress.json > /app/tmp/stress.out 2> /app/tmp/stress.time
cat /app/tmp/stress.time | grep -E 'Elapsed|User time|System time|Maximum resident'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
x=json.load(open('/app/tmp/stress.out'))
r=x['results'][0]
print('output bytes',os.path.getsize('/app/tmp/stress.out'),'streams',len(r['streams']),'total',r['received_total'],'last',r['connection'])
assert len(r['streams'])==32 and r['received_total']==32*65536
assert all(len(s['delivered_hex'])==131072 for s in r['streams'])
PY
